title: Separate matching text from training text
hints: Distinguish original content from its matching representation.
Unicode compatibility normalization precedes casefolding.
Whitespace collapse should be idempotent.

title: Give content a stable identity
hints: Choose a stable cross-process content identity.
Hash the normalized UTF-8 bytes.
Python hash is not a persistent content ID.

title: Make filtering explainable
hints: Count words and their most frequent occurrence.
The repetition denominator is total word count.
Both thresholds include equality; empty content still fails.

title: Remove exact duplicates stably
hints: Choose which duplicate record survives.
Track normalized content IDs while preserving input order.
Return new dictionaries so annotations do not modify the raw records.

title: Represent local overlap
hints: A shingle is a consecutive word window.
Enumerate only windows with all n words present.
Short documents produce no windows, not one empty window.

title: Group transitive near duplicates
hints: Similarity edges are not themselves duplicate groups.
Take connected components over the pairwise matches.
A-B and B-C edges put A,B,C together even without an A-C edge.

title: Split groups, not rows
hints: Assign one bucket to an entire group.
Choose group identity independently of input ordering.
The smallest member ID and salt determine the digest bucket.

title: Decontaminate against held-out content
hints: Check candidates against reserved content only.
Use both exact normalized matches and shingle overlap.
Short exact matches must still be removed when their shingle sets are empty.

title: Sample a reproducible mixture
hints: Separate the choice of source from the choice of record.
Sort source names before applying seeded randomness.
Zero weight removes a source from draws without changing the original data.

title: Pack without erasing boundaries
hints: Preserve three coordinate systems: document, packed row and document position.
Flush before adding a document that would overflow the current block.
Mask first-document targets and padding; do not split an oversized document silently.

title: Build isolated causal visibility
hints: Visibility requires both causality and matching segment identity.
Padding has no valid segment.
A query cannot read another document even if that key is earlier.

title: Write an immutable dataset artifact
hints: Choose serialization before computing the digest.
A newline follows each record, including the last.
Check existing outputs before writing either file.

title: Integrate the preparation pipeline
hints: Order the policies before composing them.
Validate raw IDs, then filter, deduplicate, decontaminate and group.
Annotate copied records with split and content identity before writing.
